import numpy as np
# Let t be step: t=0 is Iter 12, t=1 is Iter 11, t=2 is Iter 13
t = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0])
y = np.array([0.0768759404963025, 0.0129352896386843, 0.0207447922436496])
coeffs = np.polyfit(t, y, 2)
t_opt = -coeffs[1] / (2 * coeffs[0])
y_opt = np.polyval(coeffs, t_opt)
print("t_opt:", t_opt, "y_opt:", y_opt)
print("Corresponding fractions at t_opt:")
print("soymilk:", 0.85 - 0.01*t_opt)
print("coconut oil:", 0.030 + 0.005*t_opt)
print("SPI:", 0.025 + 0.005*t_opt)

import numpy as np

#Along v (at u=0): v = [-0.004, 0.0, +0.004], y = [0.0850789201517392, -0.000898473386426527, 0.171915233821815]
v = np.array([-0.004, 0.0, 0.004])
yv = np.array([0.0850789201517392, -0.000898473386426527, 0.171915233821815])
cv = np.polyfit(v, yv, 2)
v_opt = -cv[1] / (2 * cv[0])
print("v_opt:", v_opt, "predicted y at v_opt:", np.polyval(cv, v_opt))

# Along u (at v=0):
u = np.array([-0.014, -0.004, 0.0, 0.006])
yu = np.array([0.0768759404963025, 0.0129352896386843, -0.000898473386426527, 0.0207447922436496])
cu = np.polyfit(u, yu, 2)
u_opt = -cu[1] / (2 * cu[0])
print("u_opt:", u_opt, "predicted y at u_opt:", np.polyval(cu, u_opt))

oil_opt = (0.069 + u_opt + 0.005 + v_opt) / 2
spi_opt = (0.069 + u_opt - (0.005 + v_opt)) / 2
soy_opt = 0.905 - oil_opt - spi_opt
print(f"Optimal (soymilk, oil, spi) = ({soy_opt:.5f}, {oil_opt:.5f}, {spi_opt:.5f})")
